hooks.name: notify-needs-input

hooks.command: ~/dotfiles/scripts/notify.sh --title 'Gemini — Needs Input' --message 'Gemini is waiting for your input' --sound Ping --app-icon ~/dotfiles/scripts/icons/gemini.png

hooks.name: notify-elicitation
hooks.command: ~/dotfiles/scripts/notify.sh --title 'Gemini — Needs Input' --message 'Gemini is waiting for your input' --sound Ping --app-icon ~/dotfiles/scripts/icons/gemini.png
